title: [RACV] 5% off RACV Fuel eGift Cards (Limit 1 Per Member Per Day, 3000 Gift Cards Per Month) @ RACV (Membership Required)
body:
Deal: [RACV] 5% off RACV Fuel eGift Cards (Limit 1 Per Member Per Day, 3000 Gift Cards Per Month) @ RACV (Membership Required)

[lifeisasimulation] Which Petrol stations can this be used at?
[Tock] Yeah can't find a list of "participating locations" anywhere… Fun.
[safrane] Probably retailers with a certain merchant code, like those cinema gift cards.
[chossenger] This seems to be the case, so should Just Work so long as their PoS is setup correctly:
can be used at fuel service stations across Australia that accept Visa
[Rrpnothanx] 7eleven chopper fuel lock and pay with these for additional 5% off?
Hrmmmm
Malvern Springs WA u91 201.9 then less 5% for end cost 191.805 ish.
Pretty close to Viva Terminal Gate Price 191.29 if it links up.
[chossenger] Bought one of these yesterday, had no issue using at EG.
[sparky347] Getting the same OTP error - "Unable to send code. Please try again." I have tried website and app. Same result when trying to buy Coles gift card
[Fozdog] Can anyone please confirm this works at 7/11? Thank you
[Partu] This should work everywhere Visa prepaid fuel MCC card works. Yes, will work at 7/11.
[boomlogical] I wonder if you could use these on giftcards/phone recharges at older fuel stations?
[jeimuzu] Can this be used at Shell Express fuel stations? Can stack discount codes with flybuys and SPS app
[Save 50 Cent] Can I use this to buy winnie blues at my local servo?
[spoddar01] anyone confirm if working at BP? thanks!
[Techefy] I have racq membership, can i use that instead of racv
[WookieMonster] No.
RACQ and RACV are automotive clubs run by separate organisations, so each automotive club runs its own deals and offers.
This gift card offer is only available to RACV members. You can try to login to the RACV gift card portal using your RACQ details, but I would be extremely surprised if that would work.
I had a look at the RACQ website, and it says it sells a small range of discounted gift cards. RACQ has a Caltex fuel discount offer too.
[rayikaruga] It seems to be monthly 3000 gift card for all VIC?
[WookieMonster] Yep, my interpretation is this discount offer is only available for the first 3,000 discounted gift cards sold to RACV members each month.
[littlesoldier] tried a few credit cards also got payment refuse (eg. NAB, MyCard…)
finally used a different CVV generated from MyCard app and it works
